Score each supplied baseline measurement for its expected predictive usefulness for this task using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Assign each field ID a floating-point relevance score in [0.0, 1.0] (1.0 = most useful, 0.0 = irrelevant). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "scores" mapping every supplied field ID to its numeric score.
{"task": "At enrollment, assess maternal periodontal inflammation and the need for intensive periodontal care.", "fields": {"F4": {"description": "Body mass index at enrollment", "name": "BMI"}, "F6": {"description": "History of alcohol use", "name": "Use.Alc"}, "F11": {"description": "Prior spontaneous abortion", "name": "Spont.ab"}, "F1": {"description": "Randomized periodontal treatment assignment", "name": "Group"}, "F5": {"description": "History of tobacco use", "name": "Use.Tob"}, "F8": {"description": "Previous pregnancy", "name": "Prev.preg"}, "F0": {"description": "Maternal age at enrollment", "name": "Age"}, "F15": {"description": "Baseline percentage of sites with pocket depth at least four mm", "name": "BL..PD.4"}, "F2": {"description": "Pre-existing chronic hypertension", "name": "Hypertension"}, "F12": {"description": "Prior induced abortion", "name": "Induced.ab"}, "F14": {"description": "Baseline mean periodontal pocket depth", "name": "BL.PD.avg"}, "F3": {"description": "Baseline history of diabetes", "name": "Diabetes"}, "F7": {"description": "History of drug addiction", "name": "Drug.Add"}, "F10": {"description": "Any previous stillbirth", "name": "Any.stillbirth"}, "F13": {"description": "Percentage of sites with bleeding on probing at baseline", "name": "BL..BOP"}, "F9": {"description": "Previous live preterm birth", "name": "Live.PTB"}}}
